title: Vikram and Betal: The Three Questions
moral: Always do good in the present moment.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a king with questions.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a king who asked three important questions.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: No one can answer the questions.
scenes.text: The courtiers could not answer the king’s questions.
scenes.image_prompt: confused courtiers in royal court cartoon

scenes.text: A wise man came and listened to the questions.
scenes.image_prompt: wise man standing calmly in court cartoon

scenes.text: He said the right time is now, the important person is with you, and the important thing is to do good.
scenes.image_prompt: wise man explaining to king cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said the answers teach us to live well. Betal flew away again.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying away while vikram stands firm cartoon

story: A king asked three questions about life. A wise man answered that the present moment, the person with you, and doing good are most important. Vikram explained the lesson, and Betal flew away.
